Madhya Pradesh cabinet approves Uniform Civil Code bill

The Madhya Pradesh cabinet has approved a draft Uniform Civil Code (UCC) bill, which will be introduced in the state assembly's monsoon session. The bill reportedly includes provisions for the registration of live-in relationships and prohibits polygamy and nikah halala. The Chief Minister stated that under the UCC, only those with one marriage will have the right to live in the state.
